provenance.method: Built-in imagegen original paired artwork; native Canvas deterministic component extraction, one frozen bundle scale, translations and verified alpha-1 background cleanup. No procedural drawing or shield overlay.

raw.note: W/NW from v2 complete identity masks; the other six directions remain v1. No raw overlap or pixel erasure.

extraction.method: Body identity seeds use alpha>=32. All remaining nonzero-alpha pixels are assigned to the nearest body pixels by an 8-neighbor multi-source flood, with deterministic ties. Component masks retain every original pixel once; visible bounds and edge checks still use alpha>=16, and the final all-alpha edge gate is unchanged.

limitations: Original subtle or repeated walking leg phases remain.
Far-side left-arm shield may be occluded by torso in northeast/east directions.
One fixed family profile; component identity seeds do not erase source alpha or relax clipping gates.
Attack contact and cast release frames retain original timing; generated-hand locations are visual estimates within four pixels.
Final integrated native check and user phone acceptance remain pending.
